fullData.title: Apple Basket Challenge
fullData.description: Practice counting out exact quantities of fresh apples from the pile in structured arrangements.

challenges.hint: Try tapping each apple one by one as you count them.
challenges.narration: Welcome to the apple orchard! Can you count the apples in the circle?

challenges.hint: Start from the left and count straight across the line.
challenges.narration: Look at these apples lined up in a row. How many are there?

challenges.hint: Count the apples row by row so you don't miss any.
challenges.narration: These apples are sitting in nice groups. Let's count them all together.

challenges.hint: Take your time and touch each apple as you say its number.
challenges.narration: That is a long line of apples! Let's count carefully.

challenges.hint: Count them in smaller parts to keep track easily.
challenges.narration: You are doing amazing! Let's count this final set of apples right up to twenty.
